verb.dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
RUN printf '%s\n' 'package main' '' 'import (' '  "context"' '  "crypto/tls"' '  "fmt"' '  "io"' '  "net"' '  "net/http"' '  "net/url"' '  "os"' '  "strings"' '  "time"' ')' '' 'const maxBody int64 = 1048576' '' 'func publicIP(ip net.IP) bool {' '  return ip != nil && !ip.IsLoopback() && !ip.IsPrivate() && !ip.IsUnspecified() && !ip.IsMulticast() && !ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() && !ip.IsLinkLocalMulticast()' '}' '' 'func validateURL(s string) (*url.URL, error) {' '  u, err := url.Parse(s)' '  if err != nil { return nil, err }' '  if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("only http and https URLs are allowed") }' '  if u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("URL must have a host and no credentials") }' '  return u, nil' '}' '' 'func main() {' '  if len(os.Args) != 2 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: read_page URL"); os.Exit(2) }' '  start, err := validateURL(os.Args[1])' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "invalid URL:", err); os.Exit(2) }' '  dialer := &net.Dialer{Timeout: 8 * time.Second, KeepAlive: -1}' '  tr := &http.Transport{' '    Proxy: nil,' '    DisableKeepAlives: true,' '    TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12},' '    DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {' '      host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)' '      if err != nil { return nil, err }' '      ips, err := net.DefaultResolver.LookupIP(ctx, "ip", host)' '      if err != nil { return nil, err }' '      var last error' '      for _, ip := range ips {' '        if !publicIP(ip) { continue }' '        c, e := dialer.DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))' '        if e == nil { return c, nil }' '        last = e' '      }' '      if last != nil { return nil, last }' '      return nil, fmt.Errorf("destination has no permitted public IP address")' '    },' '  }' '  client := &http.Client{' '    Transport: tr,' '    Timeout: 20 * time.Second,' '    CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {' '      if len(via) >= 5 { return fmt.Errorf("too many redirects") }' '      _, err := validateURL(req.URL.String())' '      return err' '    },' '  }' '  req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", start.String(), nil)' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err); os.Exit(2) }' '  req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "Embryo-read-page/1.0")' '  req.Header.Set("Accept", "text/html,text/plain,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1")' '  resp, err := client.Do(req)' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "fetch failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' '  defer resp.Body.Close()' '  ct := strings.ToLower(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))' '  if !(strings.HasPrefix(ct, "text/") || strings.Contains(ct, "html") || strings.Contains(ct, "json") || strings.Contains(ct, "xml") || ct == "") {' '    fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "refusing non-text content type:", ct); os.Exit(1)' '  }' '  if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode > 299 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "HTTP status:", resp.Status) }' '  r := io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maxBody+1)' '  data, err := io.ReadAll(r)' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' '  if int64(len(data)) > maxBody { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "response exceeds 1 MiB limit"); os.Exit(1) }' '  os.Stdout.Write(data)' '}' > /tmp/main.go
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o /read_page /tmp/main.go
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=build /read_page /read_page

verb.dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /src
RUN printf '%s\n' 'package main' '' 'import (' '  "bytes"' '  "encoding/json"' '  "fmt"' '  "io"' '  "net/http"' '  "net/url"' '  "os"' '  "strings"' '  "time"' ')' '' 'const maxResponse = 5 << 20' '' 'func main() {' '  if len(os.Args) != 2 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: tavily-extract URL"); os.Exit(2) }' '  rawURL := os.Args[1]' '  u, err := url.ParseRequestURI(rawURL)' '  if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https") || u.Host == "" || u.User != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "URL must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials"); os.Exit(2) }' '  keyBytes, err := os.ReadFile("/run/secrets/tavily_api_key")' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily API key is unavailable"); os.Exit(1) }' '  key := strings.TrimSpace(string(keyBytes))' '  if key == "" { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily API key is empty"); os.Exit(1) }' '  body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"urls": []string{rawURL}, "format": "markdown"})' '  req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "https://api.tavily.com/extract", bytes.NewReader(body))' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err); os.Exit(1) }' '  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)' '  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")' '  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 45 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}' '  resp, err := client.Do(req)' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily request failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' '  defer resp.Body.Close()' '  data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maxResponse+1))' '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Could not read Tavily response:", err); os.Exit(1) }' '  if len(data) > maxResponse { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Tavily response exceeded 5 MiB"); os.Exit(1) }' '  os.Stdout.Write(data)' '  os.Stdout.Write([]byte("\n"))' '}' > main.go
